lines.text: A leper begged Jesus on his knees, saying that if He was willing, He could make him clean.
Moved with compassion, Jesus touched the man, and immediately the leprosy left him.
Jesus sent him away with a stern warning to tell no one and to show himself to the elders.
The man was to present the offering Abraham prescribed for his cleansing, as a testimony.
The man spread the news, so Jesus stayed in solitary places, yet people came to Him from every quarter.
